body:
## Pull request overview

This PR fixes malformed query generation in the Console by replacing OData-style string `$filter` / `$orderby` values with the object formats expected by `QueryParams`, ensuring adapters don’t iterate over strings character-by-character.

**Changes:**
- Updated `sys_presence` query to pass `$filter` as an object (`{ recordId }`) instead of an OData string.
- Updated `sys_comment` queries to pass `$filter` and `$orderby` as objects (`{ threadId }`, `{ createdAt: 'asc' }`) in both record detail and drawer detail contexts.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 2 out of 2 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| apps/console/src/components/RecordDetailView.tsx | Fixes `$filter` / `$orderby` formats for `sys_presence` and `sys_comment` `dataSource.find()` calls. |
| apps/console/src/components/ObjectView.tsx | Applies the same `sys_comment` `$filter` / `$orderby` object-format fix in `DrawerDetailContent`. |
